business_problem: While digitalization had made significant progress, the company identified that innovative law firms required more sophisticated tools to optimize operations and enhance client service. Due to challenges with application programming interface (API) limitations and lack of direct support, Smokeball decided to find a more robust solution.
solution_summary: Learn how the Sydney-based legal management software firm is driving profitability and enhancing efficiency for small and medium-sized law firms through AI technology on AWS. Founded in 2012, Smokeball serves over 6,000 law firms with 25,000 daily users across Australia, the UK, and the US with innovative practice management solutions. These firms often struggled with time-consuming administrative tasks that reduced billable hours and impacted client service. Recognizing this challenge, Smokeball developed Smokeball AI, a suite of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools built on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Launched in 2024, these tools automate traditionally manual tasks such as document processing, client intake, and time tracking. By transforming hours of administrative work into minutes, lawyers are now freed to focus more time on billable work and client relationships.

solution_components.name: Amazon EKS
solution_components.role: Runs containerized workloads and Kubernetes-based application services.

solution_components.name: Amazon SQS
solution_components.role: Buffers asynchronous jobs between distributed services.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or managed inference for the customer workload.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and inference APIs that power the generative AI features.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Runs event-driven compute for real-time processing without server management.

data_flow: Source data enters the Smokeball workflow through its application services, processed with Amazon EKS, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, coordinated by Amazon SQS.
business_outcome: With the help of the AWS team, Smokeball developed and launched its generative AI tools in public beta within just six months. The company's successful implementation of its tools using AWS has set the stage for continued innovation in legal technology. architecture_clues: Smokeball used Amazon Bedrock (Claude V3), a fully managed service offering access to high-performing foundation models through a single API, to equip Archie with natural language processing capabilities.
The company used AWS Lambda , a serverless compute service, to handle AI-powered responses without complex infrastructure management, streamlining operations.
Identifying the need for scalability, Smokeball deployed Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), a fully managed container orchestration service.
